title: Legal help provider
description: One place a person can get legal help or legal information about tribal law or Indian law: Native legal aid, a tribal government's legal aid office, a tribal court or state court self-help center, a state legal help website's tribal pages, or a law school clinic. Records which states and Native nations it serves, each with a source. Stored as research/legal-help/providers/<id>.yaml. scripts/legal-help/match_nations.py matches records to nation pages.

id.description: Equals the file name. Spelled out, no acronyms.

kind.description: legal-aid: a nonprofit that gives advice or representation. tribal-legal-aid: a legal aid office a nation runs for its own members. self-help-center: a court's or government's center that helps people represent themselves. legal-information-site: web pages with information or forms, no staff help. law-school-clinic: students supervised by faculty.

status.description: Omitted means open as of 'checked'. to-classify: grabbed but not yet read closely enough to rely on.

link.description: The provider's own page about this service; where none was found, the best official page, explained in 'note'.

lsc.description: Legal Services Corporation Native American service areas this provider holds.

grant_2026.description: Dollars, from LSC's notice of intent to award 2026 grants.

scope.description: statewide: Native people in every county of the states. named-nations: the source names the nations or their reservations. members: a nation's own members. region, topic, unclassified: not matched to nations.

nations.description: Nation page ids the source names (for statewide, the ones it names as examples).

link.description: A page for this part of the service, when it has its own.

match.description: inferred: the source does not name the nations; the note says how they were chosen.

text.description: What the source says, quoted or closely paraphrased.

outreach_record.description: Id of the same organization's outreach record, if any.
